$comment: PROPOSAL ONLY. Appendix A optional live interaction transfer over Core task APIs; no Exchange/Broker dependency. Illustrative descriptor and message trace, not an installable manifest or implemented SDK schema. IDs and revisions are fictional. Host derives and checks identity, workspace and grants.

message_trace.authorization_note: This records creative intent only. It cannot expand spending or generation grants.

message_trace.decision_summary: User selected a documentary visual direction.

message_trace.remaining_work: Continue generation only within existing valid grants; request authorization if insufficient.

message_trace.host_precondition: Output references resolve to authorized, validated, committed artifacts before success commits.

failure_contract.unsupported_engagement: Show supported entry options; never silently select another app or claim unavailable behavior.
failure_contract.unsupported_transition: Keep current task and owner. Two entry modes alone do not permit live switching.
failure_contract.checkpoint_required: Keep current owner until adapter confirms safe attachment; never restart the external job to switch surfaces.
failure_contract.duplicate_command: Return the previous command result; do not repeat the side effect.
failure_contract.stale_epoch: Reject with stale_owner and refresh the task snapshot.
failure_contract.stale_revision: Return conflict with current revisions; preserve proposed changes for explicit merge.
failure_contract.required_request_declined_or_expired: Keep affected steps blocked; continue only independent authorized work.
failure_contract.navigation_failed_after_commit: Keep committed owner; reconnect through task entry or explicitly release interaction.
failure_contract.app_unavailable: Keep last known task state and reconcile the same submission/run. Unknown outcome remains unresolved; report interrupted only after confirmed loss of execution with no supported recovery.
failure_contract.cancel_requested: Persist request; report cancelled only after provider confirmation.
failure_contract.direct_entry: Register an independent Host root task with engagement=direct, App origin/session, null parent_task_id and null return_session_ref. Main Chat receives no automatic completion turn; a later conversation-owner transfer requires the explicit Appendix A protocol.

task_command_boundary.authorization: Host checks authenticated identity, task scope, current interaction owner/epoch, command effects and applicable grants on every command. Caller cannot replace the adapter.
task_command_boundary.persistence: Persist command identity and receipt before delivering or acknowledging the command; duplicate commands return the existing result.
task_command_boundary.private_implementation: The App task handler and its Skill/Tool dependencies remain App-private.
